profile.bio1: I am a researcher in Artificial Intelligence. My research interests are in NLP, more specifically, text documents and text stream analysis, (semi-)automatic data exploration, and text data visualization.
profile.bio2: I am employed as a Senior Researcher at the <link1>Department for Artificial Intelligence, Jozef Stefan Institute</link1>, where I am managing a number of European Research Projects and mentoring junior researchers and students.
profile.bio3: I am employed as a Data Scientist at <link2>Event Registry</link2>, where I work on applying NLP to news data.
profile.bio4: Furthermore, I am a Teaching Assistant at the <link3>Jozef Stefan International Postgraduate School</link3>, where I assist at the AI for Data Analysis course.
